messages.author: e97222832aa0e335
messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] TMB case study collection
parts:
Very nice and very helpful! 

For any other TMB newbies, I ran into a little problem on my Mac with simpleExample, though, loading the DLL--got a message saying "could not find path-to-working-directory/simpleExample". Don't know if you'd run into the same trouble on Windows.

Looking at one of the other examples, the solution was to change 'dyn.load("simpleExample")' to 'dyn.load(dynlib("simpleExample"))'
in simpleExample.R. (I'm sure anyone familiar with TMB would have recognized this immediately.)

Cheers,

Buck
